semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical supply and disposal systems for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Puerstinger High Purity Systems GmbH designs and builds advanced supply and disposal systems for the semiconductor industry, adhering to SEMI standards. Their solutions ensure the safe delivery and precise control of process chemicals, CMP slurries, ultra-pure water, and high-purity gases, supporting key wet process steps in chip and MEMS manufacturing.
capabilities: Advanced supply and disposal systems for process chemicals
Ultra-pure water and high-purity gas delivery systems
Intelligent automation and precision flow control
